# Predictive Atom 5 (PA5)

> Preliminary AI-assisted research by Zakk Easterbrook on decision-certified key-value cache retrieval for efficient AI inference. Includes mathematical proofs, reference Python code, exact-rational tests, reproducible synthetic CPU benchmarks, raw data, and a numerical erratum.

Author and project owner: Zakk Easterbrook (https://github.com/zakkeasterbrook). Research version 0.1.0, November 24, 2026. Canonical repository: https://github.com/zakkeasterbrook/PA5. Suggested citation: Easterbrook, Z. (2026). Predictive Atom 5 (PA5): Decision-Certified Key-Value Cache Retrieval for Efficient AI Inference (v0.1.0) [Research software and preliminary research note]. https://github.com/zakkeasterbrook/PA5. Cite the exact commit where possible.

Scientific scope: single attention operation, bias-free linear readout; theorem in exact real arithmetic. Favorable concentrated synthetic attention (524,288 entries) saved 94.5% of modeled logical cache reads and measured 4.92x CPU speedup, with summary construction excluded. A later internal rerun measured 4.97x. Random and tied geometries slowed down. Original float64 implementation has a documented residual-norm underflow counterexample; an optional guarded wrapper mitigates that case but is not universally certified. No peer review, general LLM/GPU speedup, world-first status, or DOI is claimed. Public repository; Apache-2.0 licensed to the extent applicable project rights are held. See LICENSE and NOTICE.

## Research

- [Research overview and benchmark tables](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zakkeasterbrook/PA5/main/README.md): Definitions, results, reproduction and limitations.
- [Research note and mathematical proof](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zakkeasterbrook/PA5/main/paper.md): Theorem assumptions and derivation.
- [Post-publication audit and numerical erratum](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zakkeasterbrook/PA5/main/AUDIT.md): Reproduced measurements, counterexample, mitigation and limitations.
- [Coding agent guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zakkeasterbrook/PA5/main/AGENTS.md): Source map and reproduction guidance.

## Code and data

- [One-command reproduction verifier](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zakkeasterbrook/PA5/main/reproduce.py): Verify archived hashes, rerun the tests and compare recorded non-timing benchmark fields.
- [SHA-256 artifact manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zakkeasterbrook/PA5/main/ARTIFACTS.sha256): Integrity checks for original code and evidence.

- [Original algorithm](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zakkeasterbrook/PA5/main/pa5.py): Original NumPy prototype.
- [Optional guarded implementation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zakkeasterbrook/PA5/main/pa5_guarded.py): Conservative screening, not a rigorous interval implementation.
- [Exact rational tests](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zakkeasterbrook/PA5/main/exact_check.py): Reproduce real-arithmetic property tests.
- [Long-context benchmark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zakkeasterbrook/PA5/main/benchmark.py): Synthetic CPU test.
- [Additional numerical audit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zakkeasterbrook/PA5/main/audit_numerics.py): Known failure and guarded regression tests.
- [Benchmark summary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zakkeasterbrook/PA5/main/summary.csv): Aggregate original data.
- [Raw benchmark trials](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zakkeasterbrook/PA5/main/trials.csv): Per-fixture-mode measurements.
- [Raw stress trials](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zakkeasterbrook/PA5/main/stress_trials.csv): Per-evaluation numerical stress results.
- [Exact test results](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zakkeasterbrook/PA5/main/exact_results.json): Recorded algebraic validation counts.
- [Numerical audit results](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zakkeasterbrook/PA5/main/numerical_audit_results.json): Scaled-input regression results.

## Companion research: Adaptive Compute Barrier

- [ACB research overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zakkeasterbrook/PA5/main/research/adaptive-compute-barrier/README.md): Sharp two-checkpoint minimax boundary under known means, conditional METR case study, exact optimization and limitations.
- [ACB proof](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zakkeasterbrook/PA5/main/research/adaptive-compute-barrier/paper.md): Full mathematical proof and restricted multistage extension.
- [ACB research index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zakkeasterbrook/PA5/main/research/adaptive-compute-barrier/llms.txt): Code, source-data attribution and citation.
